QRadar Rule Name: [AAAA] EDS | | BRAIN Tableau AD Login Failed
qradar_rule:
APPLY [AAAA] EDS | | BRAIN Tableau AD Login Failed on events which are detected by the LOCAL system
AND when the event(s) were detected by one or more of Business Research Analytics Insights Network modules
AND when BB:BRAIN Tableau AD Logon attempt match at least 1 times with the same Obfuscated String (custom) in 1 minutes after BB:BRAIN Tableau Multiple failed match with the same Obfuscated String (custom)
SecOps Rule Logic:
rule SIEM_A_BRAIN_Tableau_AD_Login_Failed {
    meta:
        author = "leonardo"
        description = "This rule trigger when there are multiple login failures from one user for Tableu application"
        short_description = "This rule trigger when there are multiple login failures from one user for Tableu application"
        severity = "Medium"
        priority = "Medium"
        category = "Application"
        source = "HPC"
        location = "HPC"
        tool = "SIEM"
        false_positives = ""
        status = "Testing"
        created_date = "2025-07-21T09:58:00Z"
        updated_date = "2025-08-18T11:50:00Z"
        rule_version = "1.0"
        yara_version = "YL2.0"
        uuid = "f9dbe681"
        //Mitre ATT&CK
        mitre_attack_tactic = ""
        mitre_attack_technique = ""
        mitre_attack_hyperlink = ""
        mitre_attack_version = ""
        entities_udmfields = "additional.fields[\"Obfuscated String\"]"
        original_rule_name = "[AAAA] EDS | | BRAIN Tableau AD Login Failed"
        rule_conversion_notes = "A match window of 11 mins is used to account for the 10 mins in the 'BB:BRAIN Tableau Multiple failed' plus the 1 min window (after the BB) in the base rule code"

    events:
        
        $success.metadata.log_type = "BRAIN"

        $success.metadata.product_event_type = "AD Logon Attempt"
        $obfuscatedString = $success.additional.fields["Obfuscated String"]

        
        $fail.metadata.log_type = "BRAIN"
        
        $fail.metadata.product_event_type = "AD Logon Failed"
        $obfuscatedString = $fail.additional.fields["Obfuscated String"]

        $fail.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds <= $success.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds

    match:
        $obfuscatedString over 11m

    outcome:
        $risk_score = 0

        $metadata_event_timestamp_success = array_distinct($success.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
        $metadata_description_success = array_distinct($success.metadata.description)

        $metadata_event_timestamp_fail = array_distinct($fail.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
        $metadata_description_fail = array_distinct($fail.metadata.description)

        $additional_fields_agent_log_file = array_distinct($success.additional.fields["AgentLogFile"])
        $additional_fields_obfuscated_string = array_distinct($success.additional.fields["Obfuscated String"])

        $time_last_failed_login = max($fail.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
        $time_first_login_attempt = min($success.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
        $attempt_after_fail_less_1_min = if($time_first_login_attempt - $time_last_failed_login <= 60, 1)

    condition:
        $success and #fail >= 3 and $attempt_after_fail_less_1_min = 1
}
